name: mitm-core
author: Debanshu Panigrahi
description: A typed, extensible MITM proxy framework for Node.js. Built entirely in TypeScript, mitm-core provides a phased pipeline and plugin system for intercepting, inspecting, and modifying HTTP, HTTPS, WebSocket, and secure WebSocket traffic.

scripts.test:load:shutdown: npm run check:certs && npx tsx test/load/shutdown-under-load.ts
scripts.test:load:connect: npm run check:certs && NODE_OPTIONS=--expose-gc npx tsx test/load/connect-worker-load.ts
scripts.test:load:mixed-protocol: npm run check:certs && npx tsx test/load/mixed-protocol-load.ts
scripts.test:load:ws-client-abort: npm run check:certs && npx tsx test/load/ws-client-abort-load.ts
scripts.test:load:ws-upstream-abort: npm run check:certs && npx tsx test/load/ws-upstream-abort-load.ts
scripts.test:load:mixed-protocol-chaos: npm run check:certs && npx tsx test/load/mixed-protocol-chaos-load.ts
scripts.test:load:mixed-protocol-chaos-soak: npm run check:certs && NODE_OPTIONS=--expose-gc npx tsx test/load/mixed-protocol-chaos-soak.ts
scripts.test:load:mixed-protocol-chaos-long-soak: npm run check:certs && NODE_OPTIONS=--expose-gc npx tsx test/load/mixed-protocol-chaos-long-soak.ts
scripts.test:load:long-soak:http: npm run check:certs && PROTOCOL=http NODE_OPTIONS=--expose-gc npx tsx test/load/mixed-protocol-chaos-long-soak.ts
scripts.test:load:long-soak:https: npm run check:certs && PROTOCOL=https NODE_OPTIONS=--expose-gc npx tsx test/load/mixed-protocol-chaos-long-soak.ts
scripts.test:load:long-soak:ws: npm run check:certs && PROTOCOL=ws NODE_OPTIONS=--expose-gc npx tsx test/load/mixed-protocol-chaos-long-soak.ts
scripts.test:load:long-soak:wss: npm run check:certs && PROTOCOL=wss NODE_OPTIONS=--expose-gc npx tsx test/load/mixed-protocol-chaos-long-soak.ts
scripts.test:load:core-suite: npm run check:certs && tsx test/load/http1-load.ts && tsx test/load/mixed-protocol-load.ts && NODE_OPTIONS=--expose-gc npx tsx test/load/mixed-protocol-chaos-soak.ts
scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:worker
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run test && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
